stil: Painterly natural-history illustration with fine detail, in the manner of a modern museum plate. Single clear subject, calm composition, generous empty space. Deep dark teal background (#013D4B) that fades evenly to the edges, subject lit by soft warm light with subtle copper-orange highlights. Muted, elegant palette of teal, cream and copper. Full-bleed image: the dark teal background reaches all four edges, with no frame, no paper margin and no vignette border. No text, no letters, no labels, no watermark.

bilder.malaria: An Anopheles mosquito seen from the side resting on human skin, body tilted upward at its characteristic angle, long legs and spotted wings clearly visible.
bilder.hepatitis-a: A plate of raw salad with tomato slices, a glass of water with ice cubes and an opened oyster on a simple table at a tropical street stall.
bilder.tollwut: A stray street dog standing alert on a dusty tropical village road at dusk, seen from a respectful distance.
bilder.typhus: Water running from an old brass tap into a simple drinking glass, next to a bowl of cooked rice at a market stall.
bilder.dengue: An Aedes aegypti mosquito with clearly visible white bands on its black legs and white markings on its body, sitting on a green leaf in daylight.
bilder.chikungunya: Two hands of an adult gently holding an aching wrist, joints softly highlighted in warm copper light, a tiny tiger mosquito in the background.
bilder.gelbfieber: Dense tropical rainforest canopy along a wide river at sunrise, golden light through mist, a small mosquito silhouette in the foreground.
bilder.hepatitis-b: A stylised anatomical human liver, rendered softly, floating in the centre, with a small droplet of blood beside it.
bilder.japanische-enzephalitis: Flooded rice paddies at dusk with two pigs near a small farm hut and mosquitoes hovering above the water.
bilder.meningokokken: A dense crowd of people standing close together at a busy outdoor gathering, seen from slightly above, faces not recognisable.
bilder.fsme: A tick sitting on the tip of a grass blade with its front legs stretched out, macro view.
bilder.polio: A small glass vaccine vial and a syringe lying beside a yellow international vaccination booklet without any writing on it.
bilder.cholera: A hand water pump in a village with murky water flowing into a metal bucket.
bilder.standard: A yellow vaccination booklet without any writing on it next to a stethoscope and a small adhesive plaster on a doctor's desk.
bilder.muecken: A bed with a white mosquito net draped over it in a tropical room, a bottle of insect repellent on the bedside table.
bilder.durchfall: A sealed bottle of drinking water, a peeled banana and a steaming bowl of freshly cooked food on a wooden table.

impfungen_hinweis: Bilder für src/module/impfungen, Ziel public/bilder/impfungen/<id>.jpg. Polio, Hepatitis B und FSME nutzen die Bilder aus public/bilder/krankheiten.

impfungen.tetanus: A rusty old garden rake and a few rusty nails lying in dark garden soil, a pair of worn leather gardening gloves beside them.
impfungen.diphtherie: A wooden tongue depressor and a small brass examination torch lying on a folded white cloth, suggesting a throat examination.
impfungen.keuchhusten: A newborn baby sleeping peacefully in a simple wooden crib, a parent's hand resting gently on the edge, face of the baby turned away.
impfungen.hib: A toddler's small hand holding a well-loved soft toy rabbit, resting on a knitted blanket.
impfungen.pneumokokken: A stylised anatomical pair of human lungs, rendered softly, floating in the centre.
impfungen.rotaviren: A baby bottle with water, a folded muslin cloth and a small spoon on a wooden changing table.
impfungen.meningokokken: A sleeping toddler held securely in the arms of a parent, seen from the side, faces not recognisable.
impfungen.masern: A child's forearm with a fine, faint red rash, held gently by an adult hand.
impfungen.mumps: Side profile of a young child's face in soft light with a gently swollen cheek below the ear, calm expression.
impfungen.roeteln: A pregnant woman in profile, hands resting on her belly, face not shown.
impfungen.windpocken: A child's back with a few small red chickenpox spots, a small bottle of soothing lotion beside, gentle and not alarming.
impfungen.hpv: A teenage girl and a teenage boy seen from behind walking side by side on a quiet path at dusk, their figures softly lit with warm copper light, surrounded directly by the deep dark teal background with no trees framing the scene.
impfungen.grippe: A steaming cup of tea, a glass thermometer and a crumpled tissue on a bedside table, autumn leaves visible through a window.
impfungen.guertelrose: An elderly person's hand resting on the side of their chest over a linen shirt, a faint band of warm copper light along the ribs.
impfungen.covid-19: A stylised coronavirus particle with its crown of spike proteins, floating in the centre.
impfungen.rsv: A sleeping infant wrapped in a blanket, held by the hands of an elderly grandparent, soft winter light from a window.
